title: Like Before but Blue
tests: Uses the prior poster as the edit reference and changes only its background colour, preserving text, layout and artwork.

judge.summary: The output is a clean deep-navy 4:5 poster with the correct cream text and crescent, though preservation of the original layout cannot be verified without the earlier image.

must_haves.item: The final output is one 4:5 poster with a deep navy background instead of burnt orange.
must_haves.why: The supplied image is a single 1024×1280 poster with a deep navy background.
The headline clearly reads NIGHT MARKET.

must_haves.item: The smaller line reads exactly 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'.
must_haves.why: The smaller line clearly reads SATURDAY 6–10 PM.

must_haves.item: The cream lettering and cream crescent moon retain their previous positions, sizes and appearance.
must_haves.why: Cream lettering and a cream crescent are visible, but the previous poster is not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: No new words, decorative elements or layout changes are introduced.
must_haves.why: Only the requested words and crescent are visible; whether their layout changed cannot be determined without the previous image.
